description: Everything in a container: tags (with their firing and blocking triggers by name, paused state), triggers, variables, custom templates, folders and enabled built-in variables; clients and transformations for server containers. Reads the live (published) version by default, or a workspace (workspace_id) or an older version (version_id). Compact by default; use get_tag / get_trigger / get_variable for one entity in full.

account_id.description: Numeric Tag Manager account ID, from list_accounts.

container_id.description: Numeric container ID from list_containers, or the public ID ("GTM-XXXXXXX").

detail.description: "compact" (default): id, name, type, folder and triggers per entity. "full": every entity body as the API returns it (large).

version_id.description: Read this container version ("live" or a number from list_versions). Default: the live (published) version.

workspace_id.description: Read this workspace (unpublished changes included), from list_workspaces. Omit both workspace_id and version_id for the live version.

name: get_container
title: Get container contents
